resources.string: Buyekeza izicelo ezintsha bese uqhubekisela ukwamukelwa kwezilwane phambili.
Faka, hlela bese ushicilela amaphrofayela ezilwane.
Qedela iphrofayela yakho ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sesilwane.
Lesi sicelo siphikisana nedatha ekhona. Hlola iphrofayela yakho nezicelo ezikhona.
Incazelo kufanele ibe nezinhlamvu ezingu-20 kuya ku-1000.
Isibuyekezo kufanele sibe nezinhlamvu ezingu-10 kuya ku-1000.
Vula lesi silwane ku-inthanethi kuqala ngaphambi kokusigcina ungaxhunyiwe.
Awuxhunyiwe: kuboniswa izilwane ezigciniwe. Ukutholakala nebanga kungenzeka kushintshile.
